findings.title: World-space pitch clamp is inert for live ground aim; justification overstates it
findings.problem: The clamp runs on runtime.aim.direction, which in ground state equals the camera forward whose pitch CameraRig already clamps to CAMERA_LIMITS.groundPitch. So clampWorldAimPitch is a no-op on real gameplay input and only affects synthetic out-of-range vectors (the AC-1 unit test). The design presents it as a meaningful 'stays in a plausible range' guard.
findings.fix: Keep the helper (cheap and makes it independently testable) but reword the prose to note it is defensive: the camera already constrains ground pitch to the same limits, so it is a no-op for live aim. No code change required.

findings.title: 'no existing event uses a bare id' is factually wrong
findings.problem: events.ts defines { type: 'interact'; id: string } — a bare id. The rationale for naming the field broomId is inaccurate, though the chosen name is still fine.
findings.fix: Reword to 'the dominant convention is <noun>Id (itemId/questId/npcId/locationId); broomId follows it.' Keep broomId.

findings.title: questMap maps every collect objective to one hard-coded codex position
findings.problem: The resolver encodes 'collect == codex' for all items. Correct today (only one collect objective, astral-codex, verified) but silently wrong if a second collectible quest is added. New quests are out of scope, so not a blocker.
findings.fix: Add a comment at the collect case stating the single-collect-objective assumption, or key off o.itemId with a small item->position map currently containing just the codex.

findings.title: Files-touched list omits/mis-states some real paths
findings.problem: HUD.tsx actually lives at src/ui/hud/HUD.tsx; several modified files are listed without their directory. Not misleading (symbols are unambiguous) but the file list is meant to be a precise checklist.
findings.fix: Qualify the paths: src/ui/hud/HUD.tsx, src/game/core/Systems.tsx, src/ui/menus/GameMenus.tsx, etc.
